description:
Activate Conch Horn by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw two cards and then put a card from your hand on top of your library, ensuring that Venser will be among the cards revealed by Dack.
Cast Dack by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Dack enters, it triggers, revealing Venser from your library, then putting it onto the battlefield goaded, and then giving control of Venser to an opponent.
Venser's ETB ability, which triggered during Step 3, goes on the stack. Target the original Venser, which is now under an opponent's control, creating two token copies of it.
Put all but one Venser into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The two Venser tokens' abilities each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two token copies of target permanent an opponent controls other than Venser or copying target instant or sorcery they control twice.
Resolve any spell copies or ETB triggers created in Step 7.
Resolve the second trigger, creating two token copies of the original Venser.
Repeat from step 5. Depending on the targets chosen in Step 7, this will result in various other features (such as infinite artifact ETB, landfall, etc.).
